newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat as KPC term talks end.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat as KPC term talks end.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were flat despite stronger futures prices on Tuesday, traders said.
July swaps were assessed at around $180 a tonne cif NWE, unchanged from Monday's close.

Dealers were awaiting the results of the negotiations in London between KPC and potential term buyers of their naphtha. The negotiations had already ended, sources said, adding that contracts had been signed exclusively by Asian players.
Contract prices were not immediately known but traders in Tokyo said while the negotiations were ongoing that the offer price had been cut to $18.00 a tonne over the mean of Mideast quotes.
